title: 波士顿动力创始人：人形机器人竞赛，中国领先还是美国领先？
speaker: Marc Raibert

segments.en: Have you been impressed by the pace and could, you know, China continue to lead and extend its lead over the US perhaps when it comes to humanite robots.
segments.zh: 您对这样的发展速度印象深刻吗？中国是否可能在人形机器人领域继续领先并扩大对美国的优势？

segments.en: So, you know, I don't think in terms of a competition and I'm not sure I agree that China is leading or not leading. I do agree that it's a fantastic time to be in robotics. There's so much attention. There's so much resources, investors, and a lot's happening.
segments.zh: 我不从竞争的角度思考，也不确定是否同意中国领先或不领先。但我确实认为现在是机器人领域的绝佳时机，关注度极高，资源丰富，投资者众多，大量事情正在发生。

segments.en: You're right. Over the last couple of years, reinforcement learning is a technique that's really swept the globe. A number of different groups originated the work and now it's made it possible for a company to take their robot, apply those techniques.
segments.zh: 你说得对。过去几年，强化学习这项技术席卷全球。多个团队开创了这项工作，现在企业可以将这些技术应用到自己的机器人上。

segments.en: And almost immediately get it to do new, exciting things like you see at the Chinese Olympics or you see other companies using those techniques to do.
segments.zh: 几乎立刻就能让机器人做出令人兴奋的新动作，就像在中国奥运会上看到的那样，或其他公司运用这些技术所做的展示。

segments.en: You know, we see those robots lifting cars and doing backflips, but it's been hot for robots to actually do human action. I mean, David, my colleague was talking about we would love to see a robot mopping the floor, but it's not that easy to do what humans do as basic as they may seem.
segments.zh: 我们看到机器人举汽车、后空翻，但真正让机器人做人类动作一直很热门。我的同事大卫说，我们希望看到机器人拖地，但人类看似基本的动作并不容易做到。

segments.en: Absolutely true. I think part of the problem is that people don't understand how good human beings are at what they do.
segments.zh: 完全正确。我认为部分问题在于人们不了解人类在自己所做的事情上有多出色。

segments.en: And what versatility and dexterity and other features that humans have. I mean, I think at the root of it, there's a problem even in calling these robots humanoid.
segments.zh: 人类拥有多才多艺、灵巧以及其他特征。我认为根本问题在于，把这些机器人称为人形机器人本身就有问题。

segments.en: Because what does humanoid mean? Does it mean two arms, two legs and a head? Why are there maybe a hundred companies building robots with two arms, two legs and a head?
segments.zh: 因为人形意味着什么？是两条手臂、两条腿和一个头吗？为什么可能有上百家公司在制造有两条手臂、两条腿和一个头的机器人？

segments.en: When really humanoid should mean situational awareness, understanding our surroundings, mobility, dexterity, ability to use our hands or other parts of our body to move things around in a useful way.
segments.zh: 真正的人形应该意味着情境意识、理解周围环境、移动能力、灵巧性，以及用手或身体其他部位以有用方式移动物体的能力。

segments.en: Semantic understanding, understanding the world in a deeper way. All those ingredients are what make humans good at what they do and some animals good at what they do.
segments.zh: 语义理解，更深入地理解世界。所有这些要素让人类擅长所做之事，也让某些动物擅长它们所做之事。
